jobs_results.description:
Company Overview 


 Stella-Jones is a leading manufacturer of essential infrastructure products focused on serving utilities and railroads, as well as supplying big box home improvement stores across North America. Headquartered in Montreal, Canada and publicly traded on the Toronto Stock Exchange, Stella-Jones operates a vast network of facilities that employs more than 3,000 employees across the United States and Canada. Built on strong foundations with a coast-to-coast reach, we offer real opportunities for career success and community impact. To learn more about the company including a locations map, visit us at: https://www.stella-jones.com/en/inside-stella-jones 




 Position Details 


 The Risk Analyst at Stella-Jones is responsible for supporting the placement of enterprise-wide insurance policies, the reporting and oversight of delegated claims, and the overall risk management functions of the organization. This individual contributor role requires discretion and collaboration given the wide range of people and teams it interacts with across the company. It's a role suited for someone who enjoys problem-solving, is intellectually curious, and is growth oriented. 




 This position is hybrid, requiring three days per week in our Lenexa, Kansas office once initial training and team integration are complete. The role also involves some travel, up to about 10%, including trips to Stella-Jones locations across the US and Canada. 



Responsibilities:





 Collects and analyzes both financial and operational data to inform decision-making around better underwriting results, loss expectations, and risk controls.
 Collaborates with the Corporate Insurance Manager and Director of Risk Management in the Risk Management Information System (RMIS) workflow design and administration to streamline risk management processes in underwriting data collection and review, insurance certificate management, and claims reporting.
 Owns the analysis and internal reporting of insurance premium cost allocation, claims expenses, and the overall total cost of risk (TCOR).
 Performs claims oversight duties under the direction of the Corporate Insurance Manager, Director of Risk Management.
 Supports the Corporate Insurance Manager in the placement of enterprise-wide insurance policies and the management of broker and insurance carrier relationships.
 Performs other related duties as assigned within the risk management team.
Qualifications:



 BA/BS Degree in Finance, Business, Risk Management or related field.
 One or more years of analyst-level work experience, with demonstrated ability in data interpretation and financial statement analysis. (Recent Bachelor's or MBA graduates with applicable internship experience in risk management or a closely related area may also be considered.)
 Ability to understand complex processes at a detailed level.
 Excellent systems administration skills. Knowledge of programming languages a plus, but not required.
 Advanced Excel user skills.
 Ability to handle multiple functions and deadlines.
 A combination of excellent written and verbal communication skills coupled with the ability to interact at various levels of the company is essential.
 Ability to travel up to 10% across the US and Canada.
Note: Employment at Stella-Jones in the United States is contingent upon the successful completion of a pre-employment drug test and criminal background check. Also, there is no visa sponsorship available for this specific position. 




 Employee Benefits 


 As a Stella-Jones team member, you will have access to excellent benefits and incentives including: 



 Comprehensive total benefits package with 3 medical plans to choose from
 Several company-paid benefits including:
 Dental and Vision coverage
 Life insurance and Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D) policies
 Long-Term Disability Coverage
 Access to a robust employee assistance program
 Competitive compensation
 Annual bonus program opportunity
 401(k) savings plan with generous Company match (150% on the first 4% deferred)
 2 weeks paid vacation and 9 holidays
 Career advancement opportunities
 Ability to purchase Company stock

job_highlights.title: Responsibilities
items: Role Summary As a Risk Analyst in Global Fixed Income you will support the identification, measurement, monitoring, and reporting of risks across fixed income portfolios

Working closely with portfolio managers, analysts, and senior members of the risk team, you will help evaluate portfolio exposures, conduct risk analysis, and contribute to ongoing risk oversight activities
This role requires a strong analytical mindset, an interest in fixed income markets, and the ability to communicate risk findings effectively
This role reports to Head of Fixed Income Risk Management
How You Will Make an Impact Risk Analysis and Monitoring Support the monitoring of fixed income portfolios to ensure compliance with established risk limits and guidelines
Analyze portfolio exposures related to credit risk, interest rate risk, liquidity risk, market risk, and other key risk factors
Assist in identifying emerging risks and escalating findings to senior risk management professionals as appropriate
Conduct routine and ad hoc risk analyses to assess portfolio risk characteristics and trends
Risk Assessment and Stress Testing Perform quantitative analysis and stress testing to evaluate the potential impact of various market scenarios on fixed income portfolios
Assist in the development and enhancement of portfolio risk metrics and analytical tools
Support research efforts related to risk measurement methodologies and market developments
Reporting and Analytics Prepare regular risk reports and dashboards for portfolio managers, investment teams, and senior management
Assist in the production and review of performance attribution and risk reporting
Monitor data quality and ensure the accuracy and timeliness of risk analytics and reporting deliverables
Work with internal client and investment reporting teams to satisfy data requests
Collaboration and Investment Support Partner with portfolio managers, analysts, and traders to provide risk insights supporting investment decision-making
Contribute to portfolio reviews by identifying key risk exposures and discussing potential implications
Support model portfolio analytics and risk assessments for prospective and existing clients
Risk Framework and Process Support Assist with maintaining risk management policies, procedures, and documentation
Support enhancements to risk management frameworks, methodologies, and reporting processes
Participate in projects aimed at improving risk systems, tools, and operational efficiencies
Regulatory and Compliance Support Help ensure adherence to internal risk policies and applicable regulatory requirements
Monitor regulatory developments affecting fixed income investments and assist in evaluating their potential impact on risk management practices
Support internal and external audits, compliance reviews, and regulatory reporting initiatives as needed

jobs_results.description: About Us American Century Investments® is a leading global asset manager with over 65 years of experience helping a broad base of clients achieve their financial goals. Our expertise spans global equities and fixed income, multi-asset strategies, ETFs, and private investments. Privately owned and independent, we focus solely on investment management. But there’s an unexpected side to us, too. We direct 40% of our dividends every year—over $2 billion since 2000—to the Stowers Institute for Medical Research. Our ongoing financial support drives the Institute’s breakthrough work and mission of defeating life-threatening diseases like cancer and Alzheimer’s. So, the better we do for our clients, the more we can do for everyone. All who work here around the globe are inspired every day by the unique difference our hard work can make in so many lives. It shows in the curiosity we bring to every initiative, the deep relationships we build with our clients, and the way we treat each other in the hallway. If you’re excited to learn more about us, we can’t wait to learn more about you. Role Summary As a Risk Analyst in Global Fixed Income you will support the identification, measurement, monitoring, and reporting of risks across fixed income portfolios. Working closely with portfolio managers, analysts, and senior members of the risk team, you will help evaluate portfolio exposures, conduct risk analysis, and contribute to ongoing risk oversight activities. This role requires a strong analytical mindset, an interest in fixed income markets, and the ability to communicate risk findings effectively. This role reports to Head of Fixed Income Risk Management. This hybrid position will be based out of our Santa Clara, CA office. This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without visa sponsorship, now or in the future. How You Will Make an Impact Risk Analysis and Monitoring Support the monitoring of fixed income portfolios to ensure compliance with established risk limits and guidelines. Analyze portfolio exposures related to credit risk, interest rate risk, liquidity risk, market risk, and other key risk factors. Assist in identifying emerging risks and escalating findings to senior risk management professionals as appropriate. Conduct routine and ad hoc risk analyses to assess portfolio risk characteristics and trends. Risk Assessment and Stress Testing Perform quantitative analysis and stress testing to evaluate the potential impact of various market scenarios on fixed income portfolios. Assist in the development and enhancement of portfolio risk metrics and analytical tools. Support research efforts related to risk measurement methodologies and market developments. Reporting and Analytics Prepare regular risk reports and dashboards for portfolio managers, investment teams, and senior management. Assist in the production and review of performance attribution and risk reporting. Monitor data quality and ensure the accuracy and timeliness of risk analytics and reporting deliverables. Work with internal client and investment reporting teams to satisfy data requests. Collaboration and Investment Support Partner with portfolio managers, analysts, and traders to provide risk insights supporting investment decision-making. Contribute to portfolio reviews by identifying key risk exposures and discussing potential implications. Support model portfolio analytics and risk assessments for prospective and existing clients. Risk Framework and Process Support Assist with maintaining risk management policies, procedures, and documentation. Support enhancements to risk management frameworks, methodologies, and reporting processes. Participate in projects aimed at improving risk systems, tools, and operational efficiencies. Regulatory and Compliance Support Help ensure adherence to internal risk policies and applicable regulatory requirements. Monitor regulatory developments affecting fixed income investments and assist in evaluating their potential impact on risk management practices. Support internal and external audits, compliance reviews, and regulatory reporting initiatives as needed. What You Bring to the Team (Required) Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Risk Management, or a related field. 2+ years of experience in investment risk management, portfolio analytics, fixed income research, or a related financial services role. Understanding of fixed income markets, instruments, and risk concepts. Strong analytical and quantitative skills, including proficiency with Excel and risk analytics platforms. Experience working with large datasets and performing quantitative analysis. Effective written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present findings clearly. Detail-oriented with strong organizational and problem-solving abilities. Demonstrates the American Century Investments Winning Behaviors: Client Focused, Courageous and Accountable, Collaborative, Curious and Adaptable, Competitively Driven. Additional Assets (Preferred) Familiarity with risk systems such as Aladdin, Bloomberg PORT, FactSet, Yield Book, or similar platforms. Knowledge of performance attribution, portfolio analytics, and fixed income risk metrics. Experience with programming or data analysis tools such as Python, SQL, or VBA is highly preferred. Progress toward or interest in pursuing a CFA, FRM, or similar professional designation is a plus. The above statements are not intended to be a complete list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required. What We Offer Competitive compensation package with bonus plan Generous PTO and competitive benefits 401k with 5% company match plus annual performance-based discretionary contribution Tuition reimbursement, formal mentorship program, live and online learning Learn more about our benefits and perks. For New York and California based candidates, the salary range for this role is $135,000.00 - $150,000.00. Actual offers are based on various factors including but not limited to a candidate’s location, skills, experience, and relevant education and/or training. This position is eligible for cash incentive providing the potential to earn more. Employees are required to be in the office on a scheduled frequency. Adherence to this schedule is essential to fulfilling the expectations of the role. job_highlights.title: Responsibilities
items: The Information Security Governance and Risk Analyst is responsible for assessing and the [IT/Dev] department’s governance, compliance, and risk posture as they relate to its information security and information technology assets

This position provides highly skilled administrative, [technology/ development] expertise for the development and implementation of information [technology/development], governance, risk and compliance programs

Recommend programmatic and technical directions and operate with a high degree of independence in matters relating to information security program governance, risk assessments, compliance activities, and decisions regarding risk, metrics, and program improvements
Operate with a high degree of independence with regard to project management activities, including the development of project plans
Perform other duties as assigned to ensure the smooth functioning of the department and maintain the reputation of the organization as a viable business partner
